# GM Override Example

## Events that already happened

- The players have already confronted the burgomaster publicly.
- Izek did not die, but he was injured and temporarily lost some control.
- The bones were not fully recovered; only part of the related clue chain has been found.

## Current true state

- Father Lucian trusts the players and is willing to share some information privately.
- The Blue Water Inn is currently on the players' side and can provide shelter and intelligence.
- The town guard has split into at least two factions and no longer follows a single authority.

## Main plot direction to preserve

- After the side quest, the table should naturally return to the bones theft and the hidden faction in town.
- Do not insert a completely isolated quest with no follow-up value.

## Disabled content

- Do not include excessive gore.
- Do not include forced party betrayal.
- Do not introduce a comedy style that clashes with the current tone.

## Priority note

- This GM override note has higher priority than the original module text.
- If it conflicts with official material, follow this note and the actual results of the latest sessions.
